name: herdr-mobile

pnpm.//: orca declares this as `allowBuilds` in its pnpm-workspace.yaml; mobile/ is its own install root here, so it lives in package.json instead. esbuild's install script picks the platform binary — without it `postinstall` (the xterm WebView engine build) cannot run.

//bundle: `pnpm bundle` runs Metro for real — no device, no Xcode, ~8s — and produces the Hermes bytecode bundle the app would actually ship (`dist/_expo/static/js/{ios,android}/entry-*.hbc`, gitignored via the repo-root `/mobile/dist/`). It exists because the test suites mock `expo-router`, `react-native` and `expo-modules-core`, so **nothing else in this repo ever asks the real bundler whether this module graph resolves.** It is not redundant with `test`: the first run of it failed outright on `packages/herdr-client-ts`'s NodeNext `./constants.js` specifiers, which tsc and Vitest both rewrite and Metro does not (see `metro.config.js`). What it covers that no unit test can: module resolution under Metro's own rules, `metro.config.js`'s `extraNodeModules`/`blockList`/`resolveRequest`, Flow parsing of `react-native`'s own source, and Hermes bytecode conversion. Belongs in the gate list next to `typecheck`.
//deps:
Versions are pinned exactly to what orca's pnpm-lock.yaml resolved at 4fd93ead, not to its caret ranges: mobile/.prd/08-orca-port-map.md §2.1 grades package.json `copy` because "의존성 목록이 곧 검증된 버전 조합", and floating the ranges immediately broke it — react-native-webview 13.17.0 declares `class WebView

`, so `WebViewProps & P` collapses to `never` and every prop in TerminalWebView.tsx fails to typecheck. Dropped from orca's list, each because the feature is `drop` in the port map: zustand (unused in orca too, 0 files), tweetnacl + @noble/hashes + expo-crypto (E2EE), expo-camera + expo-image-picker + expo-image-manipulator + expo-document-picker (pairing QR, photo attach), @orca/expo-two-way-audio (voice), mermaid + lowlight (PR sidebar), ws (relay WebSocket), react-dom + react-native-web (web target), buffer + expo-file-system (no consumer ported yet), @types/react-native (deprecated shim; RN ships its own types), @types/ws, expo-module-scripts. orca's `patchedDependencies` (react-native@0.83.9 IME `isComposing`) is also not carried: it serves terminal live input, which is M3, and a patch we cannot regenerate is a liability now. Added, not from orca: @types/node (range, not a pin, to match the sibling packages/herdr-client-ts) — orca never type-checks its tests, so it never needed it; tsconfig.test.json here does, and the ported tests read source with node:fs.
